card.name: Commas in antiepileptic drug lists
card.fires_on: Commas or linking words right after an antiepileptic drug name (carbamazepine, clonazepam, phenytoin), just before the next drug in the list. Also 'including' before phenytoin.

modes.label: Comma in anticonvulsant list
modes.description: A comma after one antiepileptic drug, where the next name in the list is expected.

modes.label: Linking word before a drug
modes.description: The word 'including' introduces phenytoin after a mention of antiepileptic drugs.
modes.example: associated with SJS/TEN,<< including>> phenytoin. Consideration should
